title: The Little Seed Who Grew Brave
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A tiny seed who is afraid to grow discovers that courage and patience help you grow into who you are meant to be.
long_description: Sprout is a tiny seed who is afraid to grow. They long to be tall like all the other plants. When they help a ladybug feel safe, Sprout discovers a wonderful secret: courage and patience help you grow into who you are meant to be. A gentle bedtime story about bravery, kindness, and growing in your own way.
moral_lesson: Courage and patience help you grow into who you are meant to be.
visual_style: High-quality 3D animated children's illustration (cinematic children's animation)
image_generation_model: AI image-generation model (all pages AI-generated, including typography)
